basic_info.description: Discover incredible value in this beautifully updated 2-story Craftsman, ideally located in San Francisco’s desirable Crocker Amazon neighborhood. Recently appraised at nearly $1.2M, this move-in-ready home blends timeless charm with modern upgrades, offering 2 bedrooms, 2 bathrooms, a formal dining room, and a cozy living room with a fireplace. Downstairs, a versatile bonus room with a full bath offers flexibility for a guest suite, private office, or rental income potential (both unwarranted). The stylish kitchen showcases quartz countertops, a designer backsplash, custom cabinetry, and stainless steel appliances. Additional improvements include double-pane windows, updated lighting, a modern heating system, and rebuilt wooden back stairs leading to a low-maintenance backyard ideal for relaxing or entertaining. A full garage provides secure parking with expansion potential. Just steps from a convenient bus stop, this home makes commuting simple for those who prefer not to drive. You’ll also enjoy unbeatable access to Balboa BART, US-101, City College of San Francisco, I-280, Crocker Amazon State Park, Whole Foods, Safeway, restaurants and shops.
